headline: Big30 Fights Federal Case with Pooh Shiesty as Fans Demand Money & Chains
body: DJ Akademiks shared a post on Instagram on September 9, 2026, revealing Big30 is upset about fans asking for money and chains while he's battling a federal case with Pooh Shiesty. The post, which garnered 1,886 likes and 247 comments, highlights tensions within the rap community as Big30's legal troubles escalate. The caption directly states: 'Big30 goes off on people for asking him for money & chains while he’s fighting a federal case with Pooh Shiesty.'
